def factor_intraday_volume_confirmation(df):
    """Intraday return weighted by relative volume, smoothed to measure persistent price-volume coherence."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    vol_ma = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_ratio = df_copy["volume"] / vol_ma.replace(0, np.nan)
    confirmation = intraday_ret * vol_ratio
    smooth_conf = confirmation.rolling(10, min_periods=10).mean()
    factor = smooth_conf.ffill().fillna(0)
    df_copy["factor_intraday_volume_confirmation"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_intraday_volume_confirmation"]
description: This factor captures the alignment between intraday price movement and volume intensity. Intraday return (from alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday) is multiplied by the ratio of current volume to its 20-day average. Large positive (negative) values indicate strong upward (downward) intraday moves accompanied by high relative volume, signaling conviction. A 10-day rolling mean smooths the signal and identifies persistent price-volume coherence. The raw factor retains magnitude information, which can capture nonlinear relationships with future returns, potentially improving MI.
